text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I've successfully made my debut, but I really worried Trainer and my parents, who came to see me race.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It seems my body is still too underdeveloped and can't bear the stress of racing. I won't be of any help to Trainer at this rate…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But if I run well in a big G1 race like the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, I'm sure they'll be more awed than worried about me… right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky is rooting for me too. I hope I can run a lot more races and make plenty of flowers burst into full bloom.
